name: Polymarket
shortDescription: Decentralized prediction market on Polygon for real-world events.
description: A decentralized prediction market platform that enables individuals to speculate on the outcomes of future real-world events. Built on the Polygon blockchain, it offers transparent, peer-to-peer trading across politics, sports, and economics.

name: Kalshi
shortDescription: First federally regulated event contract exchange in the US.
description: The first federally regulated exchange in the United States dedicated specifically to trading on the outcome of real-world events. Regulated by the CFTC, Kalshi allows users to purchase 'event contracts' on everything from economic indicators to entertainment results.

name: Opinion
shortDescription: Decentralized prediction market and oracle protocol on BNB Chain.
description: A decentralized prediction market and oracle protocol that allows users to trade 'Yes/No' contracts on real-world events. Features an AI oracle, on-chain order book, and an incentive system for liquidity providers.

name: Predict
shortDescription: Blast-native prediction market with yield-generating positions.
description: A Blast-native prediction market leveraging Layer 2 capabilities to offer yield on positions. Users can trade on politics, sports, and crypto while earning native yield and points towards potential airdrops.

name: Limitless
shortDescription: Decentralized prediction market with daily outcome payouts.
description: A decentralized prediction market platform that allows users to trade on the outcome of future events. Limitless differentiates itself with features like daily payouts for certain markets and a focus on user experience.

name: Probable
shortDescription: Crypto-native prediction platform on BNB Chain with zero trading fees.
description: A crypto-native prediction platform built on the BNB Chain using a 'Simple Shares Mechanism'. Probable Markets offers zero trading fees (gas sponsored by the platform) and transparent on-chain settlement for trades using USDT.

name: PizzINT.watch
shortDescription: Real-time Pentagon pizza order volume tracker for geopolitical intelligence.
description: An unconventional OSINT dashboard that tracks pizza order volume at the Pentagon's nearest Dominos. Based on the 'Pizza Meter' theory, it attempts to correlate late-night pizza spikes with potential geopolitical crises or military operations.

name: Prediction Hunt
shortDescription: Aggregator tracking live odds from Kalshi, Polymarket, and PredictIt.
description: A prediction market aggregator and arbitrage tool that tracks live odds across major platforms like Kalshi, Polymarket, and PredictIt. It provides real-time market analysis, identifying arbitrage opportunities and trending markets.

name: ProbEx
shortDescription: Real-time prediction markets intelligence with AI-powered news analysis.
description: An intelligence dashboard that tracks live odds from Kalshi and Polymarket, enhanced with AI-powered news analysis to provide context for market movements.

name: Predict Shark Analytics
shortDescription: Real-time analytics, live feeds, and trader tracking for Polymarket.
description: A comprehensive analytics suite for Polymarket featuring real-time activity feeds, trending market data, and detailed trader profiles. It allows users to monitor market movements and track top-performing traders.

name: Polysights
shortDescription: Analytics and category filters for Polymarket and other prediction markets.
description: An analytics platform offering AI-driven insights, category filters, and data visualization for prediction markets. It helps users analyze trends across politics, sports, crypto, and more.

name: Polyfactual
shortDescription: AI-powered research and intelligence platform for prediction markets.
description: Provides real-time market intelligence, news analysis, and risk assessments using machine learning. Features tools like 'Insider Finder' to track trader behavior and market movements.

name: Polym.trade
shortDescription: Mobile-first trading terminal with advanced UI for Polymarket.
description: A dedicated trading terminal for Polymarket designed with a mobile-first approach. It features real-time market data, AI-powered insights, and an intuitive interface optimized for on-the-go trading.

name: The Trade Fox
shortDescription: Institutional-grade aggregator and prime brokerage for prediction markets.
description: An aggregator and prime brokerage solution offering unified access to multiple prediction markets. It provides advanced trading tools, leverage options, and aggregated insights for serious traders.

name: Betmoar
shortDescription: Pro-trading interface with UMA oracle insights and trader tracking.
description: A comprehensive trading interface for Polymarket power users. Features include advanced market analytics, trader profiling, real-time news integration, and deep insights into UMA oracle resolutions.

name: SynthesisTrade
shortDescription: Advanced trading terminal for prediction markets with focus on liquidity.
description: A sophisticated trading interface for prediction markets offering advanced tools for liquidity analysis, price discovery, and rapid execution.

name: Stand.trade
shortDescription: Market scanner and opportunity highway for Polymarket traders.
description: An advanced trading terminal featuring a powerful 'Discover' engine to filter markets by volume, liquidity, and specific events. Includes tools for finding alpha and tracking market opportunities.

name: Polydata
shortDescription: Advanced analytics dashboard for Polymarket volume, OI, and leaderboards.
description: A comprehensive analytics platform for Polymarket that tracks volume, open interest, trader leaderboards, and wallet activity. It provides deep insights into the Polymarket ecosystem and builder activity.

name: Fireplace
shortDescription: Social prediction market aggregator turning news into betting opportunities.
description: A social-first prediction market aggregator that allows users to bet on headlines and engage with friends. It aggregates markets from various platforms like Polymarket, offering a unified and social betting experience.

name: Pigeon
shortDescription: AI quant platform for automated prediction market strategies.
description: An AI-driven quantitative trading platform for prediction markets. It offers automated strategies, portfolio management, and advanced research tools for crypto, sports, and current events.

name: CopyTrade
shortDescription: Copy trading platform mirroring top Polymarket traders.
description: A dedicated copy trading interface for Polymarket, allowing users to automatically mirror the moves of profitable traders. Features include real-time wallet tracking and leaderboard analysis.

name: Kalshinomics
shortDescription: Advanced Prediction Market Analytics.
description: Prediction markets, simplified. Clean tables, fast filters, curated markets. Optimized interface to showcase important trades and analytics.

name: BetOnWars
shortDescription: The World's First Online War Room.
description: Real-time OSINT from 280+ sources in 15+ languages. Track wars, trade predictions, follow insiders. Where information becomes profit.

name: ArbBets
shortDescription: Prediction Markets Arbitrage and +EV opportunities scanner.
description: We scan thousands of markets to help you spot arbitrage and +EV opportunities. Tools include Prediction Markets Screener, Arbitrage Scanner, Positive EV Plays, and API access.

name: Kiyotaka
shortDescription: AI-powered prediction market analysis.
description: An AI analytics tool for prediction markets offering automated strategies and deep market insights.

name: Oddpool
shortDescription: The Bloomberg for prediction markets.
description: Aggregates live cross-venue odds, spreads, arbitrage opportunities, historical price data, market depth, economic indicators, and analytics across Polymarket, Kalshi, CME, and more.

name: Sportstensor
shortDescription: Decentralized AI network for sports prediction on Bittensor.
description: A decentralized artificial intelligence network designed for sports prediction that operates as Subnet 41 on the Bittensor blockchain. It aggregates numerous independent forecasts into a single, more accurate meta-model.

name: Manifold
shortDescription: Play-money prediction market with user-created markets.
description: A play-money prediction market platform where users can trade on any topic, create their own markets, and compete on leaderboards. It uses 'Mana' as a currency which can be redeemed for charitable donations.

name: Zeitgeist
shortDescription: Decentralized prediction market protocol on Polkadot.
description: A decentralized prediction market protocol built on Polkadot/Kusama. It features a futarchy governance model and an SDK for building prediction market applications.

name: Hedgehog
shortDescription: Prediction markets on Solana with high-speed execution.
description: A prediction market platform on Solana that allows users to bet on real-world events including crypto, politics, and sports. Features 'Versus' and 'Classic' trading modes.

name: Augur
shortDescription: Decentralized, trustless prediction market protocol on Ethereum.
description: The original decentralized prediction market protocol built on Ethereum. It allows users to create their own markets on any topic and trade without a central authority.

name: IBKR ForecastTrader
shortDescription: Regulated forecast contracts from Interactive Brokers.
description: A regulated platform by Interactive Brokers offering forecast contracts on political, economic, and climate events. It provides a secure environment for trading real-world outcomes.

name: Thales Market
shortDescription: Parimutuel prediction markets on Optimism and Arbitrum.
description: A decentralized protocol offering parimutuel markets, which means liquidity is pooled and shared among winners. It operates on Optimism, Arbitrum, and Base, utilizing Chainlink oracles for settlement.

name: SX Bet
shortDescription: Largest blockchain sports betting exchange.
description: A peer-to-peer sports betting exchange built on the SX Network. It offers deep liquidity, low fees, and non-custodial betting on a wide range of sports. Users can earn SX tokens through 'Bet Mining'.

name: Azuro
shortDescription: Liquidity layer and infrastructure for on-chain predictions.
description: A decentralized DAO and protocol that provides the infrastructure and liquidity for prediction markets. It uses a unique 'Liquidity Tree' model to allow developers to build betting apps on top of its shared liquidity.
